text: Then, in 1996, an amateur historian named Roger Morgan found the answer in Britain's Public Record Office. The body was Glyndwr Michael. In the late 1990s, a new line was added to the grave in Huelva.
spoken: Then, in nineteen ninety-six, an amateur historian named Roger Morgan found the answer in Britain's Public Record Office. The body was Glin-door Michael. In the late nineteen-nineties, a new line was added to the grave in Welva.
